inputs.note: parse_reported_flag over blank strings, and a FlagCrossCheck constructed with outcome=agree over reported=not_reported.

expected: A blank flag column is `not_reported`. It is not `normal`, it is not in COMPARABLE_REPORTED_FLAGS, the cross-check outcome over it is `not_reported`, and FlagCrossCheck refuses to record agreement with a flag no laboratory printed.
guards_against: A blank column treated as normal (D12, superseded by D20) — the failure that is loudest and most reassuring exactly when an extractor has lost the flag column entirely.
